note: The Randomizer line under the title logo. Each run is a byte offset into the Logo_USEU_00 texture and the ASTC blocks written there, all drawn by OOTRR, no game data. old_hash is the murmur3 (seed 0) of the original bytes the runs replace, in run order, so a different game version is refused. The texture is held twice, in the Title and in the Common layout archive, and the title screen draws the Common copy.
